answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves. What survives to the ember is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
